children: shares soared 346% premarket on Thursday as it agreed on an all-stock merger with North Immunology.
The transaction, approved by both boards, is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027.

The merger and concurrent private placement, which is expected to provide approximately $180M in gross proceeds, are expected to position the combined company to advance the development of NOR-101, a half-life extended IL-13 x IL-18 bispecific antibody that is being developed for atopic dermatitis and other immune-mediated diseases.

, the pre-merger Aethlon stockholders are expected to own ~4.75% of the combined company, and the pre-merger North Immunology stockholders are expected to own ~95.25% of the combined company, which is expected to have a pro forma equity value of ~$346.5m (inclusive of the private placement).
Upon consummation of the transaction, the combined entity will operate as North Immunology, Inc. and trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under a new ticker symbol NRTX.

title: Aethlon Medical to merge with North Immunology in all-stock deal
